output.text_response:
The search-records agent ran ten searches against FamilySearch collection 1468080 ("Norway, Marriages, 1660-1926") for Unna Halsteinsdatter (KZHH-VTX). Here is what it found:

---

**Searches run (all logged to the project):**

| Log | Query | Result |
|-----|-------|--------|
| log_001 | Halsteinsdatter / Unna, pinned to coll. 1468080 | 1 hit — different bride, Herøy 1778. Negative. |
| log_002 | Halsteinsdr / Unna, pinned | Same hit. Negative. |
| log_003 | Halsteinsdtr / Unna, pinned | Nil. |
| log_004 | Halsteinsd / Unna, pinned | Nil. |
| log_005 | Halsteinsdtr / Unna, unpinned | 502 matches; no Norwegian Unna. Negative. |
| log_006 | Halsteinsd / Unna, unpinned | Nil. |
| **log_007** | **Halsteinsdatter / Urna, pinned** | **POSITIVE — ark:/61903/1:1:NW44-PMK, "Urna Halsteinsdr", bride, married 25 Jun 1786, Hamre, Hordaland; groom Anders Monsen. Match score 0.206.** |
| log_008 | Halsteinsdatter / Udna, pinned | Negative. |
| log_009 | Halsteinsdatter / Anna, pinned | 14 hits; none in Hamre. Negative. |
| log_010 | Halsteinsdatter / Una, pinned | Negative. |

---

**One promising result — not yet confirmed as her:**

> **ark:/61903/1:1:NW44-PMK** — *Urna Halsteinsdr* married *Anders Monsen* in **Hamre, Hordaland**, on **25 June 1786**.

The entry gives no age, birth year or parentage, so the identity link to KZHH-VTX (b. May 1745, Hestdal, Meland) cannot be confirmed solely from this record. A bride aged ~41 in 1786 is consistent with the birth date but is not corroborated. No extraction or source entry was created.

**Plan item pli_001** is marked `in_progress`.

---

**Recommended next step:** Locate a Hestdal/Meland baptism record naming her parents, or an entry in the Hamre parish book that provides her age or place of origin, before treating this as her marriage entry.
